editorNotes.purpose: Original word-relationships and word-formation bank for Level 1 Stage 1, meeting the approved 20-item allocation only; not the complete stage bank.
editorNotes.reviewNotes: Original Grade 3 items covering analogies, categories, compound words, base words, prefixes and suffixes. Requires editorial and pedagogical review before approval or publication. Extend items intended to support whole-book vocabulary work are not tied to an adopted novel; review final context when the novel is selected.
